scope: Linux-only nonmutating registry-lab pre-initialization primitives under ADR-0025; STATIC EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL, default off, and without a product edge

admitted_contract.credential_transport: exact versioned sealed memfd at inherited fd 3; fd 4 absent; bounded grammar and alias rejection
admitted_contract.path_resolution: openat2 anchored traversal with RESOLVE_BENEATH, RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS, RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS, RESOLVE_NO_XDEV, and exact identity revalidation
admitted_contract.filesystem_identity: statx mount ID plus Btrfs filesystem and subvolume UUIDs
admitted_contract.layout: empty candidate root and a single exact primitive.lock fixture with pinned ownership, mode, inode, link count, and length
admitted_contract.admission: reported writable mount, configured reserve, and exact OFD whole-file write lock with a bounded deadline
admitted_contract.same_process_guard: root-keyed single active session; same-root busy and different-root invalid return before credential or filesystem syscalls
admitted_contract.success: ok_non_authoritative only; scratch and owner state wipe on close
admitted_contract.failure: unsupported, malformed, mismatched, hostile, read-only, reserve-exhausted, contended, or stale input is invalid_request, unavailable, or busy; never partial success

initial_findings: the same-process root-keyed guard was unreachable under one-shot test execution
credential alias-scan fstat errors failed open
a malformed overlapping call could close the active session's fd 3
the first guard probe inferred closure from EBADF even though fd 3 could be reused
repairs: added a live same-process guard probe
preserved the active credential descriptor across malformed overlap
bound the probe to the exact memfd readlink identity
